host_relevance: Microbial deoxycholic acid production has been associated with impaired glucose metabolism
microbial_evidence: Exact-strain studies support bile-acid deconjugation by Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron VPI-5482 and conversion of cholate to deoxycholate by Clostridium scindens ATCC 35704
selection_rationale: Mechanistically composed exact-strain test of a cholate-to-deoxycholate route; not a direct exact-pair co-culture validation
